purpose: Inventory of reframe4s HalfFlow and Flashalign evidence, with external HodgeFlow references explicitly separated from method validation.

evidenceClasses.analytic-engineering: Known-transform synthetic evidence for implementation behavior; it cannot establish acquired-image accuracy.
evidenceClasses.acquired-smoke: An acquired-image execution that checks a narrow stage or invariant without an anatomical accuracy oracle.
evidenceClasses.acquired-diagnostic: An acquired-image comparison that can reveal failures but is not an admission or release court.
evidenceClasses.acquired-qualification: A predeclared acquired-image court intended to support an accuracy or release decision. A blocked court remains qualification evidence about missing inputs, not method accuracy.

runStatuses.completed: Every declared case was attempted and retained in the result.
runStatuses.blocked-before-execution: The court rejected its inputs or implementation path before declaring or running cases.

decisions.pass: The court met its own declared, limited gate.
decisions.fail: The court ran and did not meet its declared gate, or the method failed safely.
decisions.descriptive: The court has results but no admission decision is warranted.
decisions.blocked: The intended decision is unavailable because prerequisites are missing.

halfFlowAdmission.reason: Existing acquired runs are smoke or diagnostic evidence and do not jointly provide the required multi-dataset labels or landmarks, complete exports, topology certificates, and frozen common policy.

courts.title: C04 Flashalign affine handoff
courts.task: known affine transform recovery and HalfFlow initialization
courts.evaluation: Known-transform landmark RMS and export geometry.
courts.topology: Identity-start HalfFlow failed export on two cases; Flashalign-initialized HalfFlow exported all six.
courts.headline: Supports Flashalign affine preconditioning on six synthetic affine pairs; it is not acquired T1 evidence.
limitations: Does not qualify anatomical alignment, acquired MRI, nonlinear Flashalign, or HalfFlow stable export.
courts.admissionReason: Analytic-synthetic cases do not satisfy the acquired anatomical-pair requirement.

courts.title: BasinBridge public T1 to MNI smoke court
courts.evaluation: Hash-locked NIfTI ingestion, bridge acceptance, sparse correspondence error, and true CC loss.
courts.topology: Not evaluated; the court stops after one BasinBridge round and does not export a complete bidirectional transform.
courts.headline: One real T1-to-template bridge round passed, reducing match error from 15.38 mm to 9.48 mm.
limitations: No labels, landmarks, surfaces, or TRE oracle.
No complete HalfFlow fine stage, endpoint export, or ANTs comparison.
External source-tree data have no recorded redistribution-license evidence.
courts.admissionReason: A one-stage smoke result without anatomical accuracy or export evidence is not an admitted anatomical pair.

courts.title: BasinBridge sub18 T1 to MNI diagnostic
courts.evaluation: Saved ANTs differential oracle, NCC diagnostics, brain-mask Dice and center of mass, fine-stage topology, inverse residual, and endpoint Jacobians.
courts.topology: Failed safely: the fine stage crossed the 0.05 accumulated-Jacobian floor and the intermediate endpoint had 11,434 non-positive sampled Jacobians, minimum -0.4891.
courts.headline: The partial bridge improved some diagnostics, but the complete method failed and remained far below the saved ANTs result.
limitations: One external, development-open case with no recorded redistribution-license evidence.

The stored result predates the later endpoint-boundary correction and has not been relabelled; the earlier receipt records a rematch failure and the latest reproduction retains the fine-stage topology and export failures.
A successful probe process means the negative result was recorded correctly, not that registration passed.
courts.admissionReason: The only method row is a retained topology and export failure.

courts.title: Flashalign nonlinear acquired-data qualification
courts.evaluation: The protocol requires independent landmarks or manual labels, geometry validity, inverse residual, and coverage; image similarity is secondary.
courts.topology: Not evaluated on acquired data because no registration row was declared or run.
courts.headline: The audit failed closed before execution: Flashalign has no image-backed acquired nonlinear benchmark path or admissible cohort.
limitations: Only synthetic test objectives currently connect images to the nonlinear optimizer interfaces.
No sealed multi-cohort anatomical audit or PE/reverse-PE/fieldmap strata are available.
courts.admissionReason: This is a blocked Flashalign qualification with zero executed rows, not HalfFlow evidence.

courts.title: HodgeFlow OpenNeuro ds000102 T1 to MNI screen
courts.task: six T1w subjects to MNI template
courts.evaluation: Masked, global, and gradient NCC against ANTs; sampled pullback Jacobians; secondary outline and center-of-mass diagnostics.
courts.topology: HodgeFlow completed all six with zero sampled folds and minimum total pullback Jacobian 0.0564.
courts.headline: The prospective screen failed: HodgeFlow lost mean masked NCC despite favorable global and gradient NCC.
limitations: This exercises HodgeFlow, not reframe4s HalfFlow or Flashalign.
No anatomical labels; brain extraction used ANTs tooling and runtime environments were unmatched.
courts.admissionReason: External HodgeFlow results do not exercise the HalfFlow implementation, and the court lacks labels or landmarks.

courts.title: HodgeFlow IBSR18 labeled anatomical court
courts.evaluation: Sealed anatomical-label Dice and HD95 for shared affine, HodgeFlow, and ANTs SyN, with secondary intensity diagnostics.
courts.topology: HodgeFlow retained 685 of 685 accepted updates with zero sampled folds and minimum sampled Jacobian 0.0500000149 on 2 mm grids.
courts.headline: HodgeFlow improved over affine but ANTs won all nine pairs on Dice and HD95.
limitations: This exercises HodgeFlow, not reframe4s HalfFlow or Flashalign.
One development-open cohort and subject-to-subject registration rather than T1-to-template alignment.
courts.admissionReason: External HodgeFlow evidence cannot admit the distinct HalfFlow implementation.

nextCourt.name: reframe4s acquired T1 registration court
nextCourt.minimumPurpose: Turn the existing one-off acquired diagnostics into one reproducible capture-range, accuracy, and export-safety court without using evaluation labels during fitting.
requiredOutputs: complete retained denominator and typed failure reasons
landmark or segmentation accuracy with labels held out from optimization
per-direction topology certificates over the declared evaluation region
immutable data, implementation, settings, and comparator provenance
nextCourt.promotionBoundary: A development court can organize and falsify the method. HalfFlow admission still requires at least 20 predeclared pairs from two independently sourced datasets under one frozen policy.
